title: Direct MongoDB Upload Not Working
body:
I'm trying to setup the direct MongoDB upload, but xDrip seems to have issues while trying to upload the data:

```
caught exception
java.lang.NullPointerException: Attempt to invoke virtual method 'boolean java.lang.String.startsWith(java.lang.String)' on a null object reference
```

Or has it something to do with my MongoDB instance?

comments.body: Found the issue. xDrip doesn't like special characters in the URI.
